entries.title: Numbers 13:1
segments: And the LORD spoke to Moses saying,

entries.title: Numbers 13:2
segments: Send men so that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give to the sons of Israel. You shall send a man from every tribe of their fathers, everyone a ruler among them.

entries.title: Numbers 13:3
segments: And Moses by the command of the LORD sent them from the wilderness of Paran. All those men [were] heads of the sons of Israel.

entries.title: Numbers 13:4
segments: And these [were] their names: Of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

entries.title: Numbers 13:5
segments: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

entries.title: Numbers 13:6
segments: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

entries.title: Numbers 13:7
segments: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

entries.title: Numbers 13:8
segments: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.

entries.title: Numbers 13:9
segments: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

entries.title: Numbers 13:10
segments: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

entries.title: Numbers 13:11
segments: Of the tribe of Joseph, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

entries.title: Numbers 13:12
segments: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

entries.title: Numbers 13:13
segments: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

entries.title: Numbers 13:14
segments: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

entries.title: Numbers 13:15
segments: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

entries.title: Numbers 13:16
segments: These [were] the names of the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Joshua.

entries.title: Numbers 13:17
segments: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, Go up this [way], southward, and go up [into] the mountain.

entries.title: Numbers 13:18
segments: And see the land, what it [is], and the people that live in it, whether it is strong or weak, few or many.

entries.title: Numbers 13:19
segments: And see what the land [is] that they live in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they dwell in, whether in tents or in strongholds;

entries.title: Numbers 13:20
segments: and what the land [is], whether fat or lean, whether there is wood in it or not. And be of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time [was] the time of first ripe grapes.

entries.title: Numbers 13:21
segments: So they went up and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, as men come to Hamath.

entries.title: Numbers 13:22
segments: And they went up by the south and came to Hebron, where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the sons of Anak [were]. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

entries.title: Numbers 13:23
segments: And they came to the valley of Eshcol and cut from there a branch with one cluster of grapes. And they carried it between two men upon a staff, and some of the pomegranates and of the figs.

entries.title: Numbers 13:24
segments: The place was called the valley of Eshcol because of the cluster of grapes which the sons of Israel cut down from there.

entries.title: Numbers 13:25
segments: And they returned from spying out the land after forty days.

entries.title: Numbers 13:26
segments: And they left and came to Moses and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the sons of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh. And they brought back word to them and to all the congregation, and showed them the fruit of the land.

entries.title: Numbers 13:27
segments: And they told him and said, We came to the land where you sent us, and surely it flows with milk and honey. And this [is] the fruit of it.

entries.title: Numbers 13:28
segments: However, the people that dwell in the land [are] strong, and the cities [are] walled, very great. And also we saw the children of Anak there.

entries.title: Numbers 13:29
segments: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south, and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites dwell in the mountains. And the Canaanites dwell by the sea and by the coast of Jordan.

entries.title: Numbers 13:30
segments: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses and said, Let us go up at once and possess it. For we are well able to overcome it.

entries.title: Numbers 13:31
segments: But the men that went up with him said, We are not able to go up against the people, for they [are] stronger than we.

entries.title: Numbers 13:32
segments: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched to the sons of Israel, saying, The land through which we have gone to search it, [is] a land that eats up those who live in it. And all the people whom we saw in it were men of stature.

entries.title: Numbers 13:33
segments: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, of the giants. And we were in our own sight like grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.
